detail.id: Empat bar: saron bergantian 1–2–5, bonang menjawab, kethuk dan Tak/Thung menjaga ruang. Gong menutup. Redam sengaja ditulis sebagai event. Ini komposisi modern kandidat, bukan gending tradisi terverifikasi.
detail.en: Four bars: saron alternates 1–2–5, bonang responds, kethuk and Tak/Thung leave space. Gong closes. Deliberate damps are written events. A modern candidate composition, not a verified traditional gending.

detail.id: Empat bar dengan demung 5 di awal frasa, saron 5–2–1 dan bonang di sela. Kendhang lebih jarang pada bar terakhir. Sumber Pelog asli; tanpa repitch. Validasi budaya/listening masih UNVERIFIED.
detail.en: Four bars with demung 5 starting phrases, saron 5–2–1 and bonang between them. Kendhang leaves more space in the last bar. Original Pelog sources, no repitch. Culture/listening remain UNVERIFIED.

detail.id: Empat bar: saron 1–2–5, demung 2 menandai frasa, bonang menjawab. Kethuk dan Tak/Thung berselang; gong terakhir dibiarkan selesai. Komposisi modern kandidat, bukan klaim keaslian tradisi.
detail.en: Four bars: saron 1–2–5, demung 2 marks phrases, bonang responds. Kethuk and Tak/Thung alternate; the final gong keeps its tail. A modern candidate composition with no authenticity claim.

detail.id: Empat bar dengan jawaban bonang 5–1 dan saron 5–2–1. Kendhang memberi aksen bergeser pada bar genap. Mute grup dan Jeda/Lanjut dapat dipakai untuk mempelajari lapisan. Listening masih UNVERIFIED.
detail.en: Four bars with bonang 5–1 responses and saron 5–2–1. Kendhang shifts accents in even bars. Use group mute and Pause/Continue to study layers. Listening remains UNVERIFIED.
